## Getting Started

Open a terminal on the computer that will run sqlpipe.

Install sqlpipe with this command:

```sh
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

Create a file named `sqlpipe.yaml` in your project directory.

Add the source, destination, and pipe definitions that your job needs.

Set each connection value in `sqlpipe.yaml`.

Use environment variables for passwords, tokens, and keys.

Save `sqlpipe.yaml`.

Run your first pipeline with this command:

```sh
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

Read the command output.

If sqlpipe reports an error, fix the value that the message names.

Run the command again.

If the run completes, examine the destination data.
